_doc: Hand labels (read by eye from enlarged crops, 2026-11-18). Opponent Princess HP is piecewise constant: each segment is [first_frame, last_frame, hp] inclusive. 'exclude' lists frames where the numeral was hidden at the moment of change and the true value is ambiguous. Sources: rec = runs/live/rec_dry1 raw frames f00546-f00956 (ladder, opponent level 14); the three -act runs = overlay frames of Training Camp matches (level-15 trainer), whose drawn boxes/labels sometimes cover the numerals. max_hp = the full-HP numeral.
